summary: Shares of a whole as tiles sized by value, shaded in steps of the fill so the accent recolors them. Each tile is a button; arrow keys move between them.

props.name: data
props.description: The shares, in any order; the map sorts them biggest first.

props.name: label
props.description: The heading over the map, and its accessible name.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit every value is read in.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the card and the tiles. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the map itself, such as its height. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline on each tile. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
